text: This is Halloran, UAC comms. I locked myself in control when the hangar crew stopped answering. Find the way out; I will stay on this frequency.
You are inside the containment perimeter. They sealed those doors with people still working behind them. Look for a card beside the locked routes.
The treatment plant is running without its operators. Something is moving against the current. Follow the access doors toward the exit.
That station used to report every fault to me. Now every light is green and nobody answers. Find the next passage out.
This is the laboratory sector. We kept the samples cold; that did not keep them quiet. The secured route should take you onward.
The central complex is ahead. I can hear its alarm through the wall of this room. Find the access card and keep moving.
You have reached the computing wing. The terminals are still accepting names from empty desks. Look for the route beyond the locks.
The last facility is beyond this threshold. I cannot promise what waits there. Get to the exit while this channel holds.
This annex was missing from the evacuation plan. There are voices on its local channel, all using the same name. Find a route back out.
That one's still human. Look before you shoot.
I heard that. I'll keep the channel open.
They're breathing. Thank you for waiting.
Listen to my voice. There is still a way out.
Control to anyone. Is that someone breathing on the line?
There is someone outside this room. They know my name.
Signal dropping. I can still hear you.
Please do not answer the other channel.
The banging stopped. That is worse.
I thought I heard the lift. It was above me.
Keep the receiver close. The walls carry sound here.
